question: Please list the countries of the gas stations with transactions taken place in June, 2013.

details.reason: Complete results differ from Gold SQL; BIRD Soft F1 = 0.0
details.actual_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT gs.country
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations gs ON gs.gas_station_id = t.gas_station_id
WHERE t.date >= DATE '2013-06-01'
  AND t.date < DATE '2013-07-01'
ORDER BY gs.country;
details.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.country FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.gas_station_id = T2.gas_station_id INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T3 ON T1.customer_id = T3.customer_id WHERE T3.date = '201306'
